description: This file implements UART platform-specific functions for OpenThread on Zephyr OS, including UART initialization, data transmission, reception handling, and panic mode operation.

classes.name: openthread_uart
classes.description: Structure representing UART interface with ring buffer and device info.

methods.name: uart_rx_handle
methods.description: Handles UART receive interrupt, reads data into ring buffer, signals pending events if new data arrives.

methods.name: uart_tx_handle
methods.description: Handles UART transmit interrupt, sends remaining data or disables TX when done.

methods.name: uart_callback
methods.description: UART interrupt callback handling RX and TX events.

methods.name: otPlatUartReceived
methods.description: Passes received UART data to OpenThread HDLC layer.

methods.name: otPlatUartSendDone
methods.description: Signals that UART send operation is complete.

methods.name: platformUartProcess
methods.description: Processes UART RX data and handles TX completion, called periodically.

methods.name: otPlatUartEnable
methods.description: Enables UART interface, sets up USB if needed, and configures interrupts.

methods.name: otPlatUartDisable
methods.description: Disables UART interface and USB if applicable.

methods.name: otPlatUartSend
methods.description: Sends data over UART, handles panic mode for immediate transmission.

methods.name: otPlatUartFlush
methods.description: Flushes UART output buffer, sends remaining data immediately.

methods.name: platformUartPanic
methods.description: Enters panic mode, disables UART interrupts, and sends data immediately without interrupts.
